biotools.summary: MSFragger is an ultrafast database search tool for peptide identification in mass spectrometry-based proteomics, designed to enhance sensitivity and speed, particularly when dealing with co-fragmented peptides. It is integrated within the FragPipe computational platform and utilizes a fragment ion indexing algorithm to search the full isolation window for each tandem mass spectrum.
